incidents.message: Chat messages for our EU region are processing normally again.

incidents.message: The issues with Teamwork Chat service have been resolved

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of issues logging in to Teamwork Projects US region
incidents.message: A database replica failed over and was restarted, some services experienced connectivity issues while the databases was rebooting.

incidents.name: We are experiencing delays in processing messages for Chat in our EU region
incidents.message: This incident has been resolved.

incidents.name: We are experiencing delays in database replication for Desk EU region
incidents.message:
A small number of our replica databases experienced data replication issues for Desk in our EU region. 
Normal steps to resolve this were unsuccessful so we redirected database traffic for a short time to rebuild new replica databases. 
Desk EU remained online throughout but users may have experienced some slow down during that time.

incidents.name: We are currently investigating issues with Projects in our US region
incidents.message: This issue has now been resolved.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of authentication errors in Teamwork Projects
incidents.message: Issues with authentication in Teamwork Projects have been resolved now.

incidents.name: Investigating connectivity issues with Teamwork Projects
incidents.message: A Redis cache in our US region failed over to a backup node, all Products are back to normal now.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of Projects down time in the US region for some customers
incidents.message: This incident has been resolved.

incidents.name: Degraded Drag and Drop functionality in Teamwork Projects Board view
incidents.message: A drag & drop issue for Teamwork Projects boards view has now been resolved

incidents.name: Investigating reports of Chat login issues for US region
incidents.message: This issue has been resolved, a messaging queue which Chat relies on was unavailable for a short time, causing a delay in processing.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of slowdowns for Teamwork Chat in our EU region
incidents.message: This incident has been resolved.

incidents.name: Project Notifications US region
